newsitem.title: USA: Discount Auto names Perkins president.
newsitem.headline: Discount Auto names Perkins president.

text.p: Discount Auto Parts Inc said on Thursday William Perkins had been named to president and chief operating officer.
The company said that Perkins, the executive vice president - operations, would take over the post Feb 1.
He replaces Peter Fontaine as president. Fontaine will keep his post as chief executive and remain chairman of the board.
"Bill Perkins has been a key member of the Discount Auto Parts team for more than 13 years and represents the essence of what this company is all about," Fontaine said.
"This is a logical progression in our management succession given Bill's broad understanding of Discount Auto Parts."
